- The date range covered by Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (start/end).
- Whether you can provide an interim bridge letter/attestation that covers the gap until the next Type II is issued (if applicable).

Thanks — please loop in security contacts as needed.

- PO timing: DocuSign routing for vendor agreements/bridge letter typically completes within 48 hours after you confirm acceptance; if you need the PO in hand by Aug 1, please confirm by Jul 28 so we can prioritize the signature flow.

> Vanessa outlined the high-levels — a couple of compliance clarifications from my side: 

Hi Alex,

Thanks for looping us in. Quick clarifications from Security/Compliance:

- Scope: the Type II (2026 report) covers the production inference platform, model serving runtime, and telemetry ingestion up to the point of secure storage/aggregation. It does not cover customer-managed private deployments; if your deployment is VPC/on-prem, we can provide a scoped attestation note.

- Bridge letter content: the bridge will state the audit period it covers, confirm no material control exceptions were identified during the most recent period, and note planned remediation timelines for minor findings (if any). It will not replace a future Type II; it's a time-limited attestation to help procurement.

- SIG/CAIQ: if you need SIG-lite or CAIQ answers for procurement, we've attached a condensed set of SIG responses that address network segmentation, key management, and data retention. If you need the full SIG assessment, please let us know — that typically takes a longer response cycle.

Attaching: SIG-lite-answers.xlsx (condensed answers)

If this satisfies your procurement gating, we can proceed with DocuSign and the bridge letter. Otherwise, please list any outstanding items and we'll prioritize them.

Regards,
